methodology.order: Rotated within workload; runtimes run sequentially
methodology.coefficientOrder: Descending; start at typed Integer zero, multiply then add for every coefficient
methodology.timed: Fresh RiX contexts/function binding for RiX paths; all evaluation, validation, host boundaries, input access, arithmetic and full typed sequence outputs; no coefficient plans/caches
methodology.excluded: Build/import, parsing/lowering, fixture materialization and verification
methodology.fused: Same reduced multiply/add kernels at every Horner step; private factory boxes only final result; all-Integer BigInt loop; intervals/subclasses fall back to methods
methodology.verification: Complete exact results and classes checked outside timing for every calibration/warmup/measured batch

build.changes: Copied candidate core + combined Horner operations; copied RiX source unchanged; explicit experimental registry adapter only
